mainEntity.name: Will AEO replace the need for traditional real estate advertising?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is unlikely to entirely replace traditional real estate advertising but serves as a powerful complementary strategy. While traditional advertising (e.g., print, billboards, direct mail, paid ads) can generate broad awareness, AEO focuses on capturing highly-intent users who are actively searching for specific information or services. Integrating AEO with your existing marketing efforts creates a comprehensive approach, ensuring your brokerage reaches potential clients through multiple channels at various stages of their property search journey.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO complements traditional advertising by capturing high-intent users actively searching for information. It enhances a comprehensive marketing strategy rather than replacing it.
